channel.title: Utilix
channel.description: Update feed for Utilix, an all-in-one menu bar utility for macOS.

item.title: Version 1.0.21
item.description:
## What's new in 1.0.21

- Error messages no longer appear on top of web pages that work fine
- Zoom now fits the WebChat window, and your sessions stay put
- Hovering over the chat window no longer makes it flicker
- Downloads save to your Downloads folder instead of opening as raw text
- You stay signed in when the app updates or when you quit
- Background cleanup keeps WebChat quick without interrupting you

item.title: Version 1.0.20
item.description:
## What's new in 1.0.20

- Chat pages now check that content loaded before it appears
- Stopped chat loads no longer leave a loading placeholder behind
- Fewer blank or stuck chat screens when a page fails to respond

item.title: Version 1.0.19
item.description:
## What's new in 1.0.19

- Updates now install and relaunch on their own, with no manual quit needed
- The app quietly takes over when a new version is ready to go
- No more prompts asking you to quit before an update starts
- You get back to work faster since the app restarts for you

item.title: Version 1.0.18
item.description:
## What's new in 1.0.18

- Permission checks now run silently, with no setup wizard to click through
- Permission status shows as a simple list of rows in the app
- Fixed the About window buttons and the release notes shown there

item.title: Version 1.0.17
item.description:
## What's new in 1.0.17

- Background update checks now tell you what happened every time.
- If an update fails, Utilix quietly tries again on its own.
- Retries are limited, so the app will not keep trying forever.
- Fixed a case where an update could be missed after 1.0.16.

item.title: Version 1.0.16
item.description:
## What's new in 1.0.16

- Security checks in WebChat now stay inside the app window
- Fixed WebChat getting stuck on the Loading screen
- You can now add your own custom sites to WebChat
- Long site names in the WebChat list are no longer cut off
- Added a refresh button so you can reload WebChat pages

item.title: Version 1.0.15
item.description:
## What's new in 1.0.15

- The chat window now has a slider across the top for quick adjustments.
- A new icon rail puts the main chat tools within easy reach.
- Chats open faster after the app has been idle, thanks to warm loading.
- You can now cancel a message with a single click on its icon.

item.title: Version 1.0.14
item.description:
## What's new in 1.0.14

- New WebChat lets you chat with AI right from your menu bar
- Switch between chat services using new brand tiles
- Add your own access keys in the new WebChat Settings section
- Upload files in chat and get clear messages if something fails
- The chat window now opens and closes with a smooth fade
- Fixed a bug that could save your chat history twice

item.title: Version 1.0.13
item.description:
## What's new in 1.0.13

- Color palette opens on its own once after you install or update
- Palette toggle now switches on and off more reliably
- New secure vault keeps your saved secrets encrypted on your Mac
- Your existing vault data moves over automatically, just one time
- You can now reset or export your vault data from inside the app
- Install updates with a single press, then see an Updated confirmation

item.title: Version 1.0.12
item.description:
## What's new in 1.0.12

- Calendar shows a 7-day glance with day groups and countdowns
- Translate adds a formality picker and an editable glossary
- Emoji picker now remembers your recents and favorites
- Vision text cleanup toggles are now wired up
- Send-to drafts jump straight to the right pane
- Update errors offer Retry instead of saying you're up to date

item.title: Version 1.0.11
item.description:
## What's new in 1.0.11

- Updates download quietly in the background and remind you later
- Install a downloaded update with one click from the menu bar
- Clipboard history has cleaner rows and pins no longer cover text
- The Settings window now opens in front of other apps, every time
- Saved passwords stay protected, with a one-time sign-in check

item.title: Version 1.0.10
item.description:
## What's new in 1.0.10

- Check for Updates now starts the moment you choose it.
- No second click is needed to begin checking for updates.
- The update check begins right away from the status menu.

item.title: Version 1.0.09
item.description:
## What's new in 1.0.09

- The status menu now opens neatly centered under the menu bar icon
- Software update checks now live in one place in the About window
- The About window shows the latest release notes for this version
- Small polish and internal cleanups for a smoother first release

item.title: Version 1.0.08
item.description:
## What's new in 1.0.08

- You can now check for and install updates right from Settings, under About.
- Updates are more reliable thanks to a new built-in update system.
- Fixed a problem that could leave backup files in your Downloads folder.

item.title: Version 1.0.07
item.description:
## What's new in 1.0.07

- Tapping a clipboard item now copies it instead of opening the full list
- On-screen messages now wrap at whole words so nothing gets cut off
- Pin buttons in clipboard history now show only when you hover over a row
- Pasting now only works in text areas where you can actually type

item.title: Version 1.0.06
item.description:
## What's new in 1.0.06

- Utilix now saves a safety backup of your settings before each update
- Your saved passwords stay protected during updates
- If an update is interrupted, Utilix recovers on its own
- AI notes are now on by default and work automatically
- Updates are more reliable, with automatic rollback if something fails

item.title: Version 1.0.05
item.description:
## What's new in 1.0.05

- What's New: auto-open palette banner once per version
- Release: opt-in AI polish (AgentRouter) for notes + banner stamp

item.title: Version 1.0.04
item.description:
## What's new in 1.0.04

- Status menu: AppKit-centered popup + separators between every group

item.title: Version 1.0.03
item.description:
## What's new in 1.0.03

- Release: sign with ed25519 account + key-match guard (fix 'improperly signed')

item.title: Version 1.0.02
item.description:
## What's new in 1.0.02

- Right-click menu: replace custom panel with native NSMenu (flicker + no-dismiss fix)

item.title: Version 1.0.01
item.description:
## What's new in 1.0.01

- Initial commit: Utilix macOS menu bar utility app
- Add Sparkle auto-updates, release tooling, and the isolated test app
- Performance overhaul + A-Z UI/UX pass and Keep Awake duration-switch fix
- Phase 1: ember accent standardization + rainbow cleanup
- Phase 2: type ramp floor 10pt + elevation shadow removal
- Phase 3: unify keycap renderer
- Phase 4: palette material pass
- Rewrite palette pager with SpacesRail two-finger-scroll method
- Fix snippet edit/delete, row click targets, nested-button double-fire + utility audit fixes
- Document agent workflow: architecture, research-first, production UI rules, build discipline
- Add repo-local opencode.json pointing at AGENTS.md
- Remove fixed snippet row actions from popover (hover pills in palette own edit/delete)
- Rebuild auto-type: stoppable engine, indent bypass, editable palette panel
- Auto-type refuses honestly without Accessibility instead of typing nothing
- Guard auto-type re-entry; spell out focus requirement in UI
- Make auto-type trust check and keycode map unit-testable; pin mapping/guard/refusal
- Seam auto-type event sink; prove firing order, wipe, unicode, cancel headlessly
- Auto-type newlines via Shift+Enter; expand tabs to spaces (script-faithful, never submits)
- Pin Sparkle floor to 2.9.6 (security fixes); sync docs
- Slider key/start delays with clamps; auto-restore typing focus; migrate old speed tiers
- Compact auto-type panel: header row, side-by-side sliders, short footnote
- Pin palette search bar; clip overflowing detail panes at the bottom
- Auto-type editor flexes into pane void; ember toggle
- Borderless Raycast-style search bar; loupe brightens on focus
- Drop palette close button; outside-click and Esc already dismiss
- Hover-only ghost icon row actions; drop solid text pills
- Phase 0 foundations: unify buttons/ghosts/icons/empties/motion, drop dead code
- Phase 1 palette: grouped sidebar, sectioned results, unified panes, ember AI
- Phase 2 popover: unified rows, merged placeholders, trimmed panes
- Phase 3 settings: unified rows, native About panel, cleanup feedback
- Phase 4 audit: full ember, pressed states, motion tokens, a11y labels
- Mac Vision captures everywhere via ScreenCaptureKit; clipboard append mode + text preview
- Mac Vision excludes own windows from capture; testable clipboard write path
- Mac Vision: testable OCR pipeline, blank-result guard, clipboard monitor baseline sync
- Stable self-signed identity ends the rebuild permission dance
- Shipped updates carry the stable identity; EdDSA public key matches keychain
- Stale-grant recovery script, stable DMG signing, free-forever release docs
- FDA onboarding auto-adds the list row; synchronous in-process trigger
- Never per-bundle reset FDA; add FDA probe support hook
- Fix quit-during-onboarding crash; nil-guard utilities cleanup
